title: Context Pin
description: M7 operator-maintained pin carrying the next_safe_action — the one piece of judgment the operator owes a fresh agent. M10.2 adds OPTIONAL last_writer_device + last_writer_ts attribution for cross-device LWW sync; legacy pin files without those fields still validate. Kept intentionally tiny: this is NOT a general settings file. The pin should hold a single short prescriptive next-step, not configuration, not preferences.

next_safe_action.description: Operator-maintained one-line (or short prose) guidance for the next agent. The load-bearing field — kept short and prescriptive.

last_writer_device.description: M10.2: device_id of the device that pushed this pin most recently. Optional for backward compatibility with pre-M10.2 pin files; sync-aware writers populate it on every push. Matches device-identity.device_id on the pushing device.

last_writer_ts.description: M10.2: ISO-8601 UTC of the most recent push. The LWW key for cross-device sync. Optional for back-compat; a pin without it loses LWW comparisons to a pin that has it. Push auto-stamps this to now() on the local device so explicit operator edits get attributed by the next push.
